source.notes: Served live by the API host. Server https://api.akashml.com.

model.description: The model to use for inference, e.g. `meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct`.

role.description: The role of the message author. Common values: `system`, `user`, `assistant`, `tool`. Use `developer` for system-level instructions on newer OpenAI models.

content.description: The content of the message. Can be a string, an array of content parts (text, image_url, etc.), or null for assistant messages that only contain tool_calls.

name.description: An optional name for the participant, to differentiate between participants with the same role.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls generated by the model, present on assistant messages.

tool_call_id.description: The ID of the tool call this message is responding to. Required for `tool` role messages.

messages.description: A list of messages comprising the conversation so far.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature between 0 and 2. Higher values produce more random output; lower values are more deterministic. Defaults to 1.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate. Deprecated in favor of `max_completion_tokens`.

max_completion_tokens.description: Upper bound on tokens generated, including reasoning tokens. Preferred over `max_tokens`.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling: only tokens comprising the top `top_p` probability mass are considered. Defaults to 1.

frequency_penalty.description: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Penalizes tokens based on their frequency so far, reducing repetition.

presence_penalty.description: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Penalizes tokens that have appeared at all so far, encouraging new topics.

stop.description: One or more sequences where generation stops. The stop string itself is not included in the output.

stream.description: If true, the response is streamed back as Server-Sent Events (SSE). Each chunk is a `data:` line containing a partial JSON object. The stream ends with `data: [DONE]`.

stream_options.description: Options for streaming responses. Only valid when `stream` is true.

include_usage.description: If true, a final chunk is emitted with token usage statistics.

tools.description: A list of tools the model may call. Each tool should follow the OpenAI function-calling schema.

tool_choice.description: Controls which tool the model calls. `none` disables tools, `auto` lets the model decide, `required` forces a tool call. Pass `{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "..."}}` to force a specific function.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether to allow the model to make multiple tool calls in parallel. Defaults to true.

response_format.description: Output format. Use `{"type": "json_schema", "json_schema": {...}}` for Structured Outputs, `{"type": "json_object"}` for legacy JSON mode, or `{"type": "text"}` for plain text.

seed.description: If specified, the system will attempt deterministic sampling so repeated requests with the same seed and parameters return the same result.

n.description: How many chat completion choices to generate per message. Defaults to 1.

user.description: A unique identifier representing the end-user. Useful for abuse monitoring.

logprobs.description: Whether to return log probabilities for each output token. Defaults to false.

top_logprobs.description: Number of top token log probabilities to return per position (0–20). Requires `logprobs: true`.

logit_bias.description: Map of token IDs to bias values (-100 to 100). Positive values increase, negative values decrease the likelihood of the token being selected.

service_tier.description: Latency tier for the request. Use `auto` or `default`.

modalities.description: Output types to generate. Defaults to `["text"]`. Use `["text", "audio"]` for audio output.

reasoning_effort.description: Controls how much reasoning the model does before responding. Common values: `low`, `medium`, `high`. Supported by reasoning models (o-series, etc.). gpt-oss models support `low`, `medium` and `high` only — `minimal` maps to `low`, `xhigh` and `max` map to `high`, and `none` is rejected because these models always reason.

effort.description: Reasoning effort level. Common values: `xhigh`, `high`, `medium`, `low`, `minimal`, `none`. Accepted values vary by model and provider. Takes the same per-model constraints as `reasoning_effort`, which wins if both are sent.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens to spend on reasoning.

exclude.description: If true, reasoning tokens are excluded from the response.

enabled.description: Whether to enable reasoning. Defaults to the model's default behavior.

cached_tokens.description: Prompt tokens served from the prefix cache. Present only for models that bill a cached input rate.

reasoning_tokens.description: Completion tokens spent on reasoning, for reasoning models.

model.description: Model identifier. Slashes in upstream IDs are aliased with `--` — e.g., pass `anthropic--claude-3-5-sonnet` to target `anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet`.

messages.description: Conversation history. Each message is `{ role: "user" | "assistant", content: string | ContentBlock[] }`. Content blocks include `text`, `tool_use`, `tool_result`, and `thinking`.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate before stopping. Required by Anthropic's API.

system.description: System prompt. Either a string or an array of content blocks.

top_k.description: Sample from the top K options for each subsequent token.

stop_sequences.description: Sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

stream.description: If true, the response is sent as a Server-Sent Events stream (`text/event-stream`) of Anthropic-shaped events. See the response description for the event types.

tools.description: Definitions of tools the model may call.

tool_choice.description: Controls how the model selects tools. `{ type: "auto" }`, `{ type: "any" }`, `{ type: "tool", name: "..." }`.

thinking.description: Extended thinking configuration: `{ type: "enabled", budget_tokens: number }`.

content.description: Output content blocks. Each block has a `type` (`text`, `tool_use`, `thinking`, ...) plus type-specific fields.
